purpose: Prioritize the remaining taxa with no references or fewer than nine, then fill the lowest-coverage taxa.
source_scope: Exact species-level iNaturalist observations plus GBIF still-image occurrence records and Commons file pages matched by species-name text; prioritize taxa with no references first, followed by taxa below nine, and preserve source type, underlying photo links, taxon-match warning, attribution, and licence claims.
copy_policy: Archive only photo-level CC0 or CC BY iNaturalist candidate files; keep GBIF and Commons media pages, all other rights, and unknown rights as source links for owner review.
